items.title: Language field
items.description: Books accept an optional language: a two-letter ISO 639-1 code, stored lowercase ('FR' -> 'fr'); anything else returns 400 with fields.language. API responses include language (null when absent). GET /api/books accepts ?language=<code> to filter; an invalid code returns 400.

items.title: Word count of notes
items.description: API responses include notesWordCount: the number of whitespace-separated words in notes (0 for empty notes). The book detail page shows '<n> words'.

items.title: Publisher
items.description: Books accept an optional publisher (trimmed string, max 100 characters, else 400 with fields.publisher); null when absent. GET /api/publishers returns { publishers: [{ name, count }] } for books that have a publisher, sorted by count desc then name.

items.title: Book format
items.description: Books have a format: 'paper', 'ebook' or 'audio' (default 'paper'); other values return 400. GET /api/books accepts ?format= to filter; an invalid value returns 400.

items.title: Oldest and newest
items.description: GET /api/books/oldest and GET /api/books/newest return the book with the smallest or largest year; books without a year are ignored; ties go to the lowest id. 404 when no book has a year.

items.title: Dropped status
items.description: Add the status 'dropped'. A book with status 'dropped' must have a non-empty droppedReason (else 400 with fields.droppedReason). When the status changes to anything else, droppedReason becomes null. API responses include droppedReason (null by default) and the detail page shows the reason.
